title: Population Fidelity: Evaluating Population Representativeness in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to reproduce human attitudinal variation by comparing synthetic survey responses to empirical World Values Survey data across intersectional demographic cells defined by sex, age, education, employment, and marital status.

Assessing whether models capture culture-specific attitudes by comparing generated responses to country-level survey distributions and evaluating the impact of cultural fine-tuning methods targeting specific nationalities (e.g., Germany, Mexico).
Measuring the population fidelity of LLM outputs across different age groups to see if the models accurately reproduce the observed between-group attitudinal variations.
Comparing synthetic survey responses to empirical human data across sex categories to evaluate the representation of group-level differences and detect the flattening of demographic viewpoints.
Evaluating model responses stratified by education levels and employment statuses to detect the compression or misrepresentation of socioeconomic group differences.
